## Runtime Composition Contracts

These engine capabilities are production contracts outside the frozen Unity node-row score:

- Schema-1 Operator, Block, and System VFX Subgraphs expand before CPU/GPU lowering with deterministic per-call identities, explicit dependency resolution, indirect-cycle rejection, and a default 16-level nesting bound.
- Sprite (quad), Ribbon (strip), Mesh, and Volumetric outputs preserve authored Material assets through CPU snapshots and GPU emitter records; the renderer resolves those materials or emits an explicit fallback diagnostic.
